verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents official client-side SDKs: the quickstart uses Airwallex.js, the Drop-in Element is configured via createElement(...), and its AI-agent instructions steer developers to `@airwallex/components-sdk` over the legacy library. This only covers frontend payment components. The CLI, MCP servers and code-generation skill are adjacent tools, not SDKs, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented server-side SDKs across languages, SDK reference/installation docs, breadth beyond payments UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Complete a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox environment using Airwallex.js and Airwallex-hosted payment page.
Pass appearance and layout in createElement(...).
